gaps: The nonmembers failed to be passages for different reasons: a heap keeps identity and changes no kind; rubble changes state and carries no identity; a driving side is the same kind at both levels and is merely locked. Together they induced the criterion that a passage needs a taker on the far side whose operations differ from the sender's, and that the taker strips whatever it cannot grip. This changed the question for breath two: what does the taker grip, and does the grip destroy the way back or merely leave it unread?
accepted: Order-book alembic: private guesses become a public number when a matching engine pairs each holder's bet with a counterparty, so the price arrives one level up as something a stranger can borrow against, every reason anyone had stripped in transit; not a poll, which sums beliefs of the same kind, since a price records only the last belief someone paid for.

Scatter as reading: the spread of a crowd's guesses is noise to every guesser, yet to whoever holds the whole distribution its width measures how ill-posed the question was, as temperature is a census no molecule takes; not the wisdom-of-crowds mean, which is still a guess, since a width is a kind of thing no member can have, bought by losing whose guess was whose.

The bow that can be withheld: a repeated gesture becomes an institution at the moment its omission becomes legible, so a handshake that was a movement becomes a slot that can be refused; the carrier is the expectation rather than the act, the crossing runs upward from body to polity, the gesture loses its innocence (it can no longer mean nothing) and gains a lever: refusal, insult, pardon; repetition alone is habit, and institution begins where absence signals.

Rule turned terrain: a local rule followed by many, drop scent where you found food, deposits into a shared medium a trail network no ant holds, so the rule arrives one level up as geography and returns to each ant as an environment it did not make; the carrier is residue accumulating in a medium, the rule loses its contingency (terrain feels like nature) and gains a memory outside any body; unlike the alembic the medium keeps a shape, not a number.

Error's promotion: a copying mistake in one B cell, wrong by the template's standard, becomes the organism's immunity when a selector one level up, antigen binding with clonal expansion, rewards its consequence and rewrites the standard around it; the error stays an error at its own level while becoming a function at the next, the template's authority is lost, a defense no cell designed is gained; without both an amplifier and a selector an error stays an error.

Baldwin's callus: a behavior practised in every generation, kneeling on hard ground, crosses from a life into a lineage when selection favors developmental programs that grow the callus before the habit does, so a habit arrives as an organ (the ostrich's callosities are the classical, contested illustration); the carrier is selection on plasticity, the choice is lost, reliability and freed learning capacity are gained; not Lamarck, since no callus is copied, only the disposition to grow one is bred for.

Backward brake light: a traffic jam travels upstream as a density wave while every car travels downstream, and it descends to each driver only as the brake light ahead, its shape, cause, and even its direction of motion lost; not “the whole constrains the part”, since this whole moves in a direction no part moves, and what the part receives is an imperative, not a description.

Gradient guillotined: a continuous quantity crosses into a level that can act only on verdicts and arrives as yes or no, as autoinducer concentration becomes a quorum, a fever chart a diagnosis code, a diagnosis a disability claim; upward when a colony reads its own broth, sideways when law reads medicine; degree and its uncertainty are lost, decidability is gained, and unlike dither nothing below the cut survives.

Smith no longer smiths: a nickname describing one person's trade becomes a surname carried by descendants who do not smith, description turning into identifier by inheritance across generations; upward from person to line, the truth of the description is lost, a line that strangers can trace is gained, and the crossing is one-way because the name keeps nothing from which the trade could be recovered; not a dead metaphor, which loses its image but keeps a meaning.

residue.item: Heap: many grains become a heap.
residue.why: Rejected: aggregation. The heap has every operation the grains had and no new one; nothing arrives as a different kind.

residue.item: Rubble: a bridge collapses into pieces.
residue.why: Rejected: breakdown. The pieces have a new state but nothing of the bridge is carried across as an operation at the lower level; it is the mirror failure of the heap.

residue.item: Digestion: an eaten organism becomes the eater's tissue.
residue.why: Held: it crosses two levels and nothing of the eaten organism arrives recognizably, so it looks like breakdown followed by re-aggregation; but the sense that something might still cross was strong enough to keep it for the second breath.

residue.item: Convention's cement: which side of the road to drive on becomes a population fact no one can undo.
residue.why: Rejected: one-way but not a passage. A side of the road is the same kind of thing for one driver and for all; its irreversibility is a coordination cost, not a stripped way back. Kept as the boundary case.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a physical or biological theory of levels; each item compresses an established or observed mechanism into one illustrative case, and several carriers (rite, expectation, succession) are named by the author rather than measured.

The seriation orders what a crossing does to its way back, not importance, scale, or historical order; reversibility is judged for the carrier, not for the episode (a particular bank run is not undone by desynchronizing it).

The biological items invoke established mechanisms (clonal selection, fixation by drift, genetic assimilation, prion templating) but the named cases are illustrative; the ostrich callosity is the classical and contested example of genetic assimilation and is marked as such.

“A taker on the far side” is an editorial criterion induced from the nonmembers, not an empirical finding; it may fail for crossings where the far level is purely observational and nothing there acts.
Direction labels (up, down, sideways) presuppose an ordering of levels the fieldwork did not derive; where the ordering is contestable, as between medicine and law, the item says so.

gaps: Attacking digestion under the taker question produced the fold: a breakdown that carries one thing across is a passage, and what crosses is a shape, not a substance. One-way-ness then split by cause rather than by degree: the carrier consumed the way back (Smith, Drift's monument, Ancestor manufacture, the fold), or no reader exists on the far side for it (Scatter, Rule turned terrain), or, in the rejected case, the way back merely costs coordination. Dither showed that noise added before a threshold moves a crossing from the first class to the second, which gave the seriation its hinge. Grimm's law added a carrier the first breath had not imagined: replacement of the members with no medium at all.
accepted: Prudence pooled into a stampede: each depositor's sensible withdrawal becomes a run when one shared trigger fires them together, so a solvent bank dies of an upward-arriving event that no depositor performed; the carrier is synchrony rather than a medium, nothing is integrated, and what the crossing strips is the prudence itself, sound in each and fatal in all.

Dither's bargain: hiss added to an image before hard rounding turns the structured error of quantization into featureless grain, so a banded sky arrives at the level of perception as a smooth gradient; every sample is made worse so the whole can be truer, which separates it from noise reduction: the noise is the carrier, the bargain is paid per sample, and the gradient survives the cut in aggregate.

Grimm's law has no speaker: no one changes their consonants, yet a language's consonants shift over centuries because each generation acquires a slightly different system and the previous one dies, so the carrier is replacement of the members rather than change within them; upward from speakers to language, any agent of the change is lost and a law that describes a population while binding no one is gained; unlike the trail there is no medium, only succession.

Drift's monument: a coin flip in one individual, a neutral mutation, becomes an unalterable character of the species once every alternative has been lost from the population; the carrier is fixation, the crossing is upward and one-way because what is lost is precisely the alternatives and with them the way back, and a trait with no reason is gained; unlike Error's promotion nothing selected it, so its permanence is an absence, not a function.

The fold that survives the meal: digestion destroys every level of an eaten organism above the molecule, yet a prion's conformation passes through and arrives in the eater as a rule its own proteins begin to obey; the carrier is a shape templating shapes, everything but the fold is lost, a folding rule the body never had is gained; this is the case that separates passage from breakdown: a breakdown that carries one thing across is a passage.

Ancestor manufacture: a death becomes, through funerary and genealogical rite, a different kind of object at the level of the lineage, an ancestor who can be invoked, owed, and blamed; upward, the person (body, voice, the power to answer back) is lost and a standing claim on the living is gained, one-way because the death itself is the carrier; not memory, which keeps the person's kind, since an ancestor is a creditor.

Looping diagnosis: a classification made to describe people, once known by those it describes, changes how they act and describe themselves, so it descends to each person as a way of being and returns to the classifiers with altered contents; the carrier is the classified's knowledge of the class, the classification loses its independence from its objects, a new kind of person is gained; a mean that becomes “normal” is the same descent before the return trip.

Investiture: an office descends into one person so that the person's acts count as the institution's acts, a nation signing only through a hand, while the office keeps its continuity across successive bodies; downward from whole to member, the acts are lost as the person's own and the whole gains the ability to act at all; unlike Looping diagnosis it changes what the acts count as, not what the holder believes.

Crack to border: a fracture in rock is only damage until water takes it, deepens it into a valley, a river settles there, and a treaty names the river, each level taking the shape the one below left and adding its own kind; upward through scales, the crack is lost and a line with legal existence is gained; rubble that no water enters stays rubble, so a breakdown becomes a passage only when the next level's process uses the broken shape.

residue.item: The average becomes a should: a population mean descends into each member as a standard they fall short of.
residue.why: Merged into Looping diagnosis: a summary that arrives as a norm is the same descent before its return trip, and the members' pursuit of the norm is what sends it back; kept as the discriminator clause there.

residue.item: Footprint outlives foot: a trackway turns a walk into a rock.
residue.why: Rejected: record-making, which Rule turned terrain and Ancestor manufacture already carry with sharper gains; a trackway obliges no one and constrains nothing, so what arrives is a trace of the same kind as any trace.

residue.item: Event pinned to ground: a battle becomes a place name.
residue.why: Merged into Smith no longer smiths: same carrier, a name outliving its description by inheritance; the difference of target (place instead of line) did not change what is lost or gained.

residue.item: Forecast that moves the crowd: a prediction alters what it predicts.
residue.why: Rejected: duplicates Forecast with teeth in question-metamorphoses, and its crossing is reflexive rather than between levels.

residue.item: Return address kept: a passage that archives what it strips, so the far-side thing can be unmade.
residue.why: Held as the wild probe rather than admitted: it is a property a passage may have, not a passage, and its live question (is a thing that can be sent back still a different kind?) belongs to the next expedition on Ancestor manufacture.

neighbors.left: Dither's bargain: hiss added to an image before hard rounding turns the structured error of quantization into featureless grain, so a banded sky arrives at the level of perception as a smooth gradient; every sample is made worse so the whole can be truer, which separates it from noise reduction: the noise is the carrier, the bargain is paid per sample, and the gradient survives the cut in aggregate.
neighbors.right: Gradient guillotined: a continuous quantity crosses into a level that can act only on verdicts and arrives as yes or no, as autoinducer concentration becomes a quorum, a fever chart a diagnosis code, a diagnosis a disability claim; upward when a colony reads its own broth, sideways when law reads medicine; degree and its uncertainty are lost, decidability is gained, and unlike dither nothing below the cut survives.
neighbors.separating_case: A pass/fail examination with a cut score. Guillotine: every score becomes a verdict and the cohort's distribution of ability below the cut is gone from the verdicts. Dither: add a small random offset to each score before applying the same cut; every verdict is still binary and each is slightly less fair, but the proportion passing across the cohort now traces the whole score distribution, so the gradient can be read back from the verdicts. Same threshold, same binary output; noise before the cut is the only difference, and it decides whether the way back exists.

checks.boundary_case: Which side of the road a country drives on is tempting: an arbitrary individual choice becomes a population fact that no one can undo. It is out because nothing arrives transformed: a side of the road is the same kind of thing for one driver and for all of them, and its irreversibility is a coordination cost, not a stripped way back. Aggregation with a lock is still aggregation, as a heap is still sand.
checks.form_inference: Loop and re-entry. The alembic → brake light → stampede → alembic cycle descends and then re-ascends, so the third item feeds the first from one level up; a line shows three neighbors and hides the return. Drift's monument → Error's promotion is a re-entry across the selector fork: what the seriation places far apart, a functionless fixation and a selected function, are one late selector apart. Dither × Guillotine is an incompatibility at a single threshold, which adjacency can only hint at; the edge states what an institution must do about it.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each item names a carrier, a direction, and what the crossing strips and supplies; the strange members (a fold crossing a meal, a law with no speaker, a wave that moves against its members) were kept strange rather than restated as emergence, and the one-way question was answered by mechanism, not by mood.

next_crossfield_opening: Takers that must be built: connect Crack to border, Unborn witness (question-metamorphoses), and Missing alarm (traces-of-the-unlived); ask what it costs to construct the far-side process that turns a breakdown or an absence into a passage, and whether building the taker changes what arrives.

gaps: The Dither → Guillotine hinge overclaimed where it was asserted rather than proposed: image dither works because neighbouring pixels resample the same true value, but a cut score applied once per person yields one binary per person, so a jittered cut recovers only the density within the noise's width of the cut, from grouped pass rates, and nothing about scores far from it. The mechanism survives bounded (an institution that jitters its cut learns how many marginal cases it has) and the hinge survives because any way back at all separates the two classes. Structurally, the taker criterion the fieldwork used to admit and reject members was absent from the declared type, which as written admitted the fossil and the trackway the ledger had rejected; it is now in `of`.
accepted: Investiture: an office descends into one person so that the person's acts count as the institution's acts, a nation signing only through a hand, while the office keeps its continuity across successive bodies; the carrier is the counting-as rule fixed by oath or appointment, the direction is downward from whole to member, the acts are lost as the person's own and the whole gains the ability to act at all; unlike Looping diagnosis it changes what the acts count as, not what the holder believes.

Grimm's law has no speaker: no speaker sets out to change their consonants, yet a language's consonants shift over centuries because each generation acquires a slightly different system and the previous one dies, so the carrier, on the acquisition account of sound change, is replacement of the members rather than change within them; upward from speakers to language, any agent of the change is lost and a law that describes a population while binding no one is gained; unlike the trail there is no medium, only succession, and where speakers drift within a lifetime the medium returns and the item no longer applies.

Smith no longer smiths: a nickname describing one person's trade becomes a surname carried by descendants who do not smith, description turning into identifier by inheritance across generations; upward from person to line, the truth of the description is lost, a line that strangers can trace is gained, and the crossing is one-way because the name keeps the word and drops the referent, so a stranger can read that someone once smithed but never who, nor whether the line still does; not a dead metaphor, which loses its image but keeps a meaning.

Drift's monument: a coin flip in one individual, a neutral mutation, becomes a character of the whole species once every alternative has been lost from the population, so that until a new mutation reopens the choice nothing can be preferred instead; the carrier is fixation, the crossing is upward and one-way because what is lost is precisely the alternatives and with them the way back, and a trait with no reason is gained; unlike Error's promotion nothing selected it, so its permanence is an absence, not a function.

Ancestor manufacture: a death becomes, through funerary and genealogical rite, a different kind of object at the level of the lineage, an ancestor who can be invoked, owed, and blamed; upward, the person (body, voice, the power to answer back) is lost and a standing claim on the living is gained; the carrier is the rite, and the crossing is one-way because the rite can only be performed on a death, which nothing on the far side can undo; not memory, which keeps the person's kind, since an ancestor is a creditor.

residue.item: Backward brake light → Prudence pooled into a stampede (edge)
residue.why: The old antecedent (every member answers the local imperative with the same move) yields a relayed wave, which is the brake light again; synchrony needs one trigger every member hears at once, so the label now says so and can fail.

residue.item: Dither's bargain → Gradient guillotined (edge) and the neighbors separating_case
residue.why: 'A recoverable gradient' and 'traces the whole score distribution' promised more than a single jittered cut delivers; both now claim only the region within the noise's width of the cut.

residue.item: The bow that can be withheld (placement)
residue.why: Its way back exists whenever the polity's expectation lapses, a reader-class return; the critic argued the placement and the author's own roll-call had skipped it.
The critic suggested the item say the rule never returns as a rule, but marked it keep rather than repair; the placement is now defended in seriation.note instead of editing the item.

The mechanism described is Waddington's genetic assimilation under Baldwin's name; the critic called the naming loose but not a repair, and boundary_claim already names genetic assimilation and marks the case contested.
Carrier is implied (whoever holds the census); the critic accepted it under the taker reading and left naming optional.

residue.item: Error's promotion ('the template's authority is lost')
residue.why: Interpretive compression; the critic kept it as authored.

limits: The dithered way back is bounded: a cut jittered once per member recovers only the density within the noise's width of the cut, and only from grouped pass rates; image dither's full-gradient recovery depends on resampling the same true value many times, which a single verdict per person does not do.

Membership is now explicitly reader-relative: the declared type requires something at the far level that operates on what arrives, so the same carried shape is rubble with no reader and a passage with one.
seed: The mirror of dither: noise added not to save a way back but to choose which one dies. Randomized response and differential privacy add noise before aggregation so that the aggregate survives the crossing and the way back to any individual is consumed, which is the guillotine's loss aimed at the members and the bargain's gain kept for the whole. The map's axis treats the way back as one thing; this case shows a carrier that keeps the return to the level and destroys the return to the member, and asks whether every passage has two ways back that a carrier can trade against each other. The author's near priority explicitly sets privacy noise aside; it is the next item, not a distraction.
